title: Home Services
summary: A Raspberry Pi backend for camera recording, file recovery and secure handoffs between Apple apps.
oneLiner: A Raspberry Pi backend for camera recording, file recovery and secure handoffs between Apple apps.

caseStudy.problem: A Mac can sleep or disconnect while cameras, backups and mobile workflows still need an always-available endpoint.
caseStudy.role: I designed and deployed the service contracts, Raspberry Pi runtime and Mac status tooling.
architecture: Camera Monitor and Files & Backups can use a versioned API on the Pi with scoped tokens.
Private relays can queue selected editorial and opportunity edits for a Mac. The Chew Sense mailbox accepts encrypted recording deposits.
decisions: Keep the camera and file apps usable with their direct providers. Separate status, write access and publication permissions.
validation: Camera and file provider adapters have been exercised against the deployed Pi. The encrypted recording mailbox is deployed.
